headerDisplay: Halo garage door and light for Apple Home. Halo must be running on this machine (or set its address below).

apiUrl.title: Halo Address
apiUrl.description: Where Halo is running. Use 127.0.0.1 or the Pi's home-network IP, never a Tailscale address.

showLight.title: Show light button
showLight.description: Adds a switch that toggles the opener light. It flips back off after each tap, because Halo can't see whether the light is on.

scriptPath.title: garage_door.py path (legacy mode only)
scriptPath.description: Only if you don't run the Halo server: leave Halo Address empty and set this instead.

doorTravelTime.title: Door Travel Time (seconds, legacy mode only)
